---
name: Feature request
about: Something the app should do and does not
labels: enhancement
---

**What you want to do**
Describe the task, not the control. "Print two parts one after the other on one
plate" says more than "add a sequential printing checkbox".

**How you do it today**
The workaround, if there is one. That is the thing being replaced.

**Which printer**
Tool changer, single nozzle, or both. Several features here exist because a tool
changer makes them matter.
